question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: ‘A state of temporary disuse or suspension.’
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option (3)' i.e. **Abeyance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **‘abeyance’** means a state of temporary disuse or suspension. (अस्थायी निलंबन या स्थगन)

 
 
• **Example:** The project is in abeyance until further notice.
 
 
 
• This word is often used to describe situations where an activity, process, or rule has been paused but not ended permanently. (यह शब्द अक्सर उन परिस्थितियों में प्रयोग होता है जहाँ कोई कार्य, प्रक्रिया, या नियम अस्थायी रूप से रोका गया हो।)
 
 
• **Example:** The law was held in abeyance during the emergency. (आपातकाल के दौरान कानून को स्थगित कर दिया गया था।)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Abeyance**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pause** (ठहराव): A temporary stop or break in activity.

 
 
• **Example:** She pressed the pause button to stop the video.
 
 
 
• **Lapse** (भूल/समाप्ति): A temporary failure or a period in which something is invalid or inactive.
 
 
• **Example:** His insurance policy has lapsed due to non-payment.
 
 
 
• **Standstill** (ठहराव): A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.
 
 
• **Example:** The traffic came to a standstill during the parade.
